text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for curfew, but the lights
in the
gym are still on, so I go to
investigate what's
going on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right. Done with the barbell. Next up
is fifty
leg presses.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Hey, curfew's coming up pretty soon.

text_block_list.text:
So? I'm in the zone here, so don't bother
me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
So? I'm in the zone here, so don't bother
me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Shut up. Like I need telling.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Heeeey! Taishiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ugh. Another member to add to the
rabble. Just
what I need.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We didn't get to play the funny-face
version of
rock, paper, scissors at lunch,
so let's hurry back
and play it now!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Will you stop with that?! I'm not gonna
play it, no
matter how much you run
after me and pester me
about it!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ooh! If you want me to run after you,
that must
mean you wanna play tag
instead! Okay, get
ready, 'cause I'm
gonna catch ya!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: What?! That's not what I even—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ready, set, GOOOO!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Oh, come on!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Who do you think I am? I know how to
watch my
limits just fine!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I notice an open notebook
under
Нарита Таисин's training
equipment. It's filled with
meticulously
planned exercises.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey! Who told you you could look at my

notebook?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It's just what I have to do to make
sure I
win.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I have to work hard to make up for all
the talents
and attributes I wasn't
blessed with.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Waaaah! That's so moviiing!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, not you again, Ticket! Why are you
always
bursting into tears?! It's so
annoying!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I came—hic!—to get you, but after hearing your story... Waaah! You're so amazing, Taishiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You're so cool, but I'm worried you're
pushing
yourself too hard! Don't overdo
iiiit!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, okay. I got it. There's no
way I can
focus like this.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин dashes off with terrifying
ferocity,
leaving Уиннинг Тикит in her
dust.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Look, I'll go back now, so stop crying!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
